questions.question:
Find the part of the given sentence that has an error in it. If there is no error, choose 'No error.

I know Rohan has been going through a tough time latter.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** primary issue** in the sentence is the **incorrect usage** of the word "**latter**."
 
• The word "**latter**" refers to the second of two items or people previously mentioned and is not appropriate in this context.
 
• The correct word to use is "**later**," which refers to **a time subsequent to the present.**
 
• Thus, the error is located in **part 1** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"I know Rohan has been going through** a tough time later.**"*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Part 2: "I know Rohan has,"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Part 3: "No error"** – This would be the correct option if there were no mistakes in the sentence, but there is an error in part 1.
 
• **Part 4: "been going through,"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

• Example: She wanted to come** too,** but she had other plans.

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate word to fill in the blank.

As a child, he was tender and warm - hearted towards ________.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence requires a word that refers to people, as **it describes the child's warm-hearted nature towards others.**
 
• The term** "everybody"** fits best in the context, indicating a general warm-heartedness towards all people.
 
• Options like "one", "everywhere", and "whomever" do not fit well in the context of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"As a child, he was tender and warm-hearted towards **everybody**."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "one"** – This does not fit the context as it refers to an individual person rather than a group.
 
• **Option 3: "everywhere"** – This refers to places, not people, thus is not suitable.
 
• **Option 4: "whomever"** – This refers to any person, but the sentence requires a more general term like "everybody."

questions.question:

• **Example:** They tried to dissuade her from leaving the job.
 
 
 
• **Assist** (सहायता करना): To help or aid someone.
 
 
• **Example:** The nurse assisted the doctor during the operation.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.
